shots.storyline: Indoor badminton hall with a blue court, green surrounds, a net across mid-frame, and YONEX / 旭日星空 banners overhead; a 李宇轩教练 + bilibili watermark sits top-right. The clip opens mid-exchange: S01-P02 has the shuttle already falling from high above the net (frames 0.0–0.2) and completes an overhead strike around 0.3, sending the shuttle descending toward S01-P01's right (screen-right) side (0.4–0.9). S01-P01, initially in a wide ready stance, steps out to his forehand side, meets the low shuttle near 0.9–1.0 with a right-handed sideways-to-upward swing, and the shuttle rises high back over the net center at 1.1 before leaving view; he then recovers to a ready stance by 1.6–1.9 while P02 resets. Around 2.0–2.3 P02 winds up overhead again and launches a high arcing delivery into P01's court (shuttle visible 2.3–2.9 descending to P01's right). P01 again reaches forehand-side, contacts low near 2.9–3.0, and the shuttle climbs to screen-right (3.1–3.3) then begins descending (3.4–3.8); the clip ends with that shuttle still in flight and P01 returning upright. No speech or sounds are available to this stage.

shots.storyline: Single static shot of an indoor blue badminton court with green surrounds and sponsor banners overhead. S02-P01 (near, back to camera) performs two overhand hand-feeds: at ~3.9 s he releases a shuttle from his raised right hand and it descends across the net into S02-P02's right forecourt (screen left). S02-P02 lunges forward and plays a low underarm stroke (~4.5-4.6 s); the shuttle then climbs steeply above the net tape (visible at 4.667 s) and leaves the tracked view, after which S02-P02's racket finishes high (4.767-4.967 s) and he steps back to a ready stance by ~5.3 s. Both players hold position until ~5.6 s, when S02-P01 again raises the shuttle in his right hand and releases it (~6.0 s); the second feed descends to the same forecourt area (6.1-6.4 s). S02-P02 lunges once more, strikes low near the net (~6.6 s), and the shuttle rises above the net toward screen left (6.867 s); his follow-through keeps the racket up through ~7.2 s before he recovers to an upright ready stance. The clip ends with S02-P01 still standing with racket lowered at his left side and S02-P02 in a crouched ready position; no racket stroke by S02-P01 is visible in this shot, his feeds are bare-hand tosses.

shots.storyline: A single static medium shot of one coach-like figure standing on an indoor badminton court, framed against a dark hall with a blue 'YONEX' banner overhead and a '李宇轩教练 bilibili' watermark at top right. At 7.633 s he stands upright, racket lowered at his right side (screen-left), left hand raised in an open explanatory gesture, mouth open as if speaking. Between 7.733 s and 7.833 s the racket is lifted from the lowered position to a vertical hold beside his head; the 7.733 s frame shows the racket head motion-blurred during the raise, and by 7.833–7.933 s the racket is held steady, head pointing up near the top of the frame, while his left hand continues to gesture and he keeps smiling/talking. This racket raise is a conversational illustrative gesture, not a stroke: no shuttle is visible at any point, there is no striking preparation toward an incoming bird, and no contact or outgoing path occurs. At 7.967 s (final sampled frame) a Chinese subtitle line appears at the bottom while the pose is unchanged. The shot ends with him still holding the racket upright and gesturing; the action is ongoing/cropped at the boundary. Feet remain essentially planted in a standing stance with no discernible footwork pattern.
